# OrderMAX

> OrderMAX is a free Shopify app for cart upsells, cross-sells, gift-with-purchase (GWP), BOGO / Buy X Get Y offers, and AI-matched product recommendations. It includes real-time funnel analytics and automated A/B testing.

## Key facts

- Category: Shopify app — cart upsell, cross-sell, and promotions
- Price: Free — every feature included. No paid tier, no order cap, no revenue share.
- Rating: 5.0 on the Shopify App Store
- Shopify App Store listing: https://apps.shopify.com/ordermax-1
- Company: Manhattan, New York, NY, United States
- Core capabilities: adaptive storefront widgets (auto-match store theme), gift-with-purchase and BOGO/Buy X Get Y campaigns, AI product recommendations, real-time offer-funnel analytics, automated A/B testing, Shopify Sidekick integration for conversational campaign management

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://ordermax.io/): product overview, ROI calculator, FAQ
- [Free upsell app for Shopify](https://ordermax.io/free-upsell-app-shopify/): what "free" means here vs. capped free plans and trials, what is included at $0, evidence on upsell AOV impact, FAQ
- [Best free upsell apps for Shopify, compared](https://ordermax.io/blog/best-free-upsell-apps-shopify/): seven Shopify upsell apps with free plans, compared by what ends the free tier (total store orders, lifetime orders, attributed revenue, funnel views); pricing read from each Shopify App Store listing on 2026-08-26 and quoted verbatim; includes vendor-bias disclosure
- [Free vs paid upsell apps for Shopify](https://ordermax.io/blog/free-vs-paid-upsell-apps-shopify/): the economics of choosing a free vs. a paid upsell app — net-gain math, what a fee typically buys (volume headroom, deeper targeting, support), tiered evidence (McKinsey cross-sell attribution, AfterSell AOV-lift data), FAQ
- [What is a Shopify upsell app?](https://ordermax.io/blog/what-is-a-shopify-upsell-app/): vendor-neutral category definition — upsell vs. cross-sell vs. order bump, the four placements offers run in (product page, cart, checkout, thank-you page), objection handling, tiered evidence, FAQ
- [Compare Shopify upsell apps](https://ordermax.io/compare/): hub for 20 head-to-head comparison pages — OrderMAX vs. 7 competitors (Selleasy, Essential, BOGOS, iCart, Upsell.com, Honeycomb, Wiser AI), plus 13 competitor-vs-competitor pages; pricing read from each vendor's own App Store listing
- [Offers & promotions hub](https://ordermax.io/offers/): overview of all offer types
- [Gift with purchase (GWP)](https://ordermax.io/offers/gift-with-purchase/): what GWP is, how to set it up, FAQ
- [BOGO & Buy X Get Y](https://ordermax.io/offers/bogo-buy-x-get-y/): what BOGO/BXGY is, how to set it up, FAQ
- [AI cart upsell](https://ordermax.io/offers/ai-cart-upsell/): how AI product recommendations work, FAQ
- [Discount stacking](https://ordermax.io/offers/discount-stacking/): what discount stacking is, margin risk, how to control it, FAQ
- [Privacy policy](https://ordermax.io/privacy-policy)
